verdict.rationale: A live probe found a well-formed llms.txt at https://docs.snyk.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200, a structured 'Snyk User Docs' index linking to .md pages). The docs are also served as raw markdown URLs (e.g., snyk-code.md, remediation-agent.md), so an agent can ingest them directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt/agent-oriented docs, evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content bundle, and independent corroboration of agents using it in practice.
